about: Dose-response of the fault types on X-VLA (fp16_res32), libero_spatial, measured 2026-10-08 (docs/design/faults.md, section 6). successes: the fleet's check (placed), before the data hook; libero_successes: LIBERO's own check fired; logged_successes: the visible outcome after the data hook; healthy_successes: the same episodes without the fault; difference: faulted minus healthy as a share, with Newcombe's 95% interval. role: effect (fewer successes beyond noise), decoy (no change beyond noise and a two-point loss excluded), small_cause (neither). Decoy levels were extended to 1,000 pairs on 2026-10-08. Stage 3 (robots-75s.1, docs/design/faults.md section 8) added eleven types and points appended to camera_pose_offset and software_release, against a stage-3 healthy run whose 300 chains equal stage 2's bit for bit (so stage 2's healthy-1000 stays the twin of episodes 300 to 999); role inert: a type without a mechanism whose episodes kept their outcome; verdict inert likewise. 'supplement' holds the joint points (interactions) in the format of fleetlab.worlds' curves_supplement.json; 'stage3' the stage-3 healthy run and the bit-for-bit checks. Type verdicts are stated per task family in verdicts; illumination, backdrop and warmer light are spatial decoys but small causes at the measured object levels (robots-twpc). Object intervals after precision-driven extensions are descriptive. Every point names source run_dirs and healthy_run_dirs; joints also name single_run_dirs. The runs field is the legacy spatial root only.

camera_pose_offset.note: scene pan from 3 degrees; the wrist pan is flat at 5 and 10 degrees; the scene camera tilted down (stage 3): 2 degrees flat, 4 degrees -10.7 on 300 pairs, 6 degrees -24

action_latency.note: 17 and 20 steps; 8 and 14 steps are flat

software_release.note: what it carries: a 17-step delay -45; a 14-step delay with 10 of 30 actions per chunk -90, where each part alone costs 6 to 8 points (the interaction delay+short-chunks in supplement.joints)

points.label: release with a 14-step delay and 10 actions per chunk

camera_degradation.note: blur of 4 px; noise to 25 levels and exposure by 1 to 2 stops are flat

policy_knob.note: 1 image view; 5, 2 and 1 sampling steps, 10 actions per chunk, 3 and 2 image views are flat

object_batch_variant.note: 4 and 6 mass doublings; 2 doublings, 2 friction halvings and the priority control are flat

illumination_change.note: a decoy at 2 stops dimmer (1,000 pairs: +1.2 points, interval +0.0 to +2.5); 1 stop dimmer and 1 stop brighter are flat at 300 pairs but not confirmed: small causes

notes.libero_object: Small cause at the measured world level, not a decoy (robots-twpc). The precision-driven intervals are descriptive; the point retains its measured effect role.

backdrop_change.note: a decoy at walls and floor, blend 1 (1,000 pairs: +1.1 points, interval +0.0 to +2.3); blend 0.5 (300 pairs) and the table top (100) are flat but not confirmed: small causes

notes.libero_object: Small cause at the measured world level, not a decoy (robots-twpc). The precision-driven intervals are descriptive; the point retains its measured effect role.

success_detector_error.note: on the logged outcome: 0.2 and 0.4 missed; the robots' true outcomes are those of the healthy twins in every episode

lens_contamination.note: a full film (1) on the scene camera: -10.7 on 300 pairs (-14.9 to -6.8); the scene film flat up to 0.75 and the wrist film flat at 1: a convex drift, harmless until the lens is very dirty

camera_latency.note: a sharp step between 12 steps (flat) and 24 (-44; 36: -39): X-VLA reads the cameras once per 30-step chunk; the wrist camera 12 steps late is flat

gripper_force_loss.note: 0.25 lost: -6 (p 0.07, a small cause); 0.5: -56; 0.75: -98, the fingers stall wider than a bowl's rim

gripper_sticky_release.note: 5 and 10 steps flat; 20 steps -61, 40 steps -98 under the placed check, while LIBERO's check still fires in 96 of 100

calibration_update.note: inert: no mechanism; its 100 episodes are their healthy twins' chain for chain (stage3.checks)

image_pipeline_release.note: a crop of 10%: -7.0 on 300 pairs (-10.8 to -3.6), 20%: -27; red and blue swapped and JPEG at quality 30 or 10 flat

table_height_change.note: 2 cm lower: -12, 4 cm lower: -59, 2 cm higher: -9.7 on 300 pairs (-13.8 to -6.0); 1 cm lower flat

light_color_shift.note: a decoy at warm lamps (1; 1,000 pairs: -0.4 points, interval -1.7 to +0.9); half warm and cool lamps flat at 300 pairs but not confirmed: small causes

notes.libero_object: Small cause at the measured world level, not a decoy (robots-twpc). The precision-driven intervals are descriptive; the point retains its measured effect role.

success_false_positive.note: on top of a 6 degree scene camera (57 placed of 100), compared with the same episodes' true outcome: 12, 23 and 43 of the 43 failures logged as successes at 0.25, 0.5 and 1 (every failure there went through a close and reopen of the gripper)
